segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: Good morning everyone, let us start with the supplier offer from Northwind.

segments.speaker: Dóra Minta
segments.text: Jó reggelt. A tanácsadó tízmillió forintot kér a negyedévre, ez benne van az ajánlatban.

segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: That is ten million forints for the whole quarter, which is above our budget.

segments.speaker: Cleo Test
segments.text: Can we ask Nortwin for a smaller scope? The robot arm at the harbour site comes first.

segments.speaker: Dóra Minta
segments.text: A határidőről még nem beszéltünk, Bennel egyeztetek pénteken.

segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: Agreed. Send Dórának the draft so she can check the numbers.

segments.speaker: Cleo Test
segments.text: I will send the offer in writing by Friday.

segments.speaker: Dóra Minta
segments.text: A Northwind Tradersnél a projekt felelőse még nincs kijelölve.

segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: Then we follow up next week with the fleet management team.

segments.speaker: Cleo Test
segments.text: One more thing, the pallet labels at the harbour need a new printer.

segments.speaker: Dóra Minta
segments.text: Rendben, a nyomtatót a jövő héten megrendeljük, a raktár már várja.

segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: On logistics: the trucks arrive at seven, unloading takes two hours, and the scanners still drop about one pallet in fifty, which we will fix with the new firmware before the next audit.

segments.speaker: Cleo Test
segments.text: The weekly report covers deliveries, damaged pallets and the scanner rollout at both docks.

segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: Thanks all, talk next week.

segments.text: Jó reggelt, a tanácsadó tíz millió forintot kér a negyedévre.

segments.speaker: Ben Sample
segments.text: That is ten million forints for the whole quarter, above our budget.

title: Recorder summary
text:
The consultant costs ten million forints a quarter.

The offer comes in writing by Friday.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The fleet dashboard shows each robot's battery and position on one map.

segments.speaker: Cleo Test
segments.text: Can we add the charging queue to the fleet dashboard before the pilot?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Yes, and the alerts go to the night shift by text message.
